claim: The element the configuration calls csuw1_port and the emission splitter that sends light to one camera or the other are one mechanism inside the CSU-W1 unit, not two devices. The splitter is the port. There is no standalone camera_splitter device on this instrument.
validity_conditions: This instrument as configured on 2026-09-17, operator read at the instrument (operator_read:kyuhwan_20260917). No numeric condition applies, so a query's condition_range comes back unconstrained rather than satisfied. Falsified by a second splitting element being fitted, or by the loaded device list showing two independently addressable mechanisms.
